From 01/01/2025 to 31/12/2025 التجميع: Customer SAR
How to read the sales reports

Every report here reads from the same ledger — so two figures differing between two reports means a different period, branch or filter, not a different source.

Ranges are always inclusive of both ends, and compare against the **document** date, not the entry date.

What you see is bounded by your data scope: a rep sees their own customers, someone with full scope sees everyone — so two users seeing different figures is not a fault.

Cancelled and reversed documents do not count, because a reversal is an opposing entry in the same ledger.

And exporting outputs what is displayed after filtering, not the whole table.
